# Komut satırı araçları

Görüntüleyicinin `tools/` klasöründeki komut satırı araçları (Node.js, depo kökünden çalıştırılır). Görüntüleyiciyi kullanmak için bunlara hiçbir zaman ihtiyaç yoktur: verilerinizi paketler, özetler ve dönüştürürler; görüntüleyiciyi sürdürenlere de yardımcı olurlar. Her girdide aracın kendi açıklamasının ilk paragrafı ve kullanım satırları vardır; varsa, tam yardım için bir aracı argümansız çalıştırın. [İlgili depoların](index.md#related-repositories) veri araçları kendi komutlarını belgeler.

## Verileriniz için {#for-your-data}

### `3dheat-pack.mjs`

Packs converted matches into `.3dheat` containers, one file a match (docs/container.md), and back.

```
node tools/3dheat-pack.mjs [pack] <folder|file>... [--delete-loose] [--jobs N] [--settle MIN]
node tools/3dheat-pack.mjs unpack <folder|file.3dheat>... [--delete-container]
node tools/3dheat-pack.mjs verify <folder|file.3dheat>...
node tools/3dheat-pack.mjs update <file.3dheat> [--add <role>[:<member name>]=<file>]... [--remove <member name>]...
node tools/3dheat-pack.mjs repack <folder|file.3dheat>...
```

### `3dheat-summarize.mjs`

The mass index (docs/mass-analysis.md): every `.3dheat` match under the folders gets its summary (`src/mass/summarize.ts`) - the match, its vehicles, teams, players and weapons, its phases, its grid - written into the container as the `summary` member, once; a match summarised already (by this version) is only read. Then one index per folder:

```
node tools/3dheat-summarize.mjs <folder>... [--jobs N] [--force] [--no-write] [--no-index] [--limit N] [--settle MIN]
```

### `acmi-to-parquet.mjs`

Tacview ACMI recordings (.acmi, .zip.acmi, .txt.acmi) to Parquet, a whole folder at a time, for the many-match overlay: one Parquet file per recording, the folder tree kept, so a map or a scenario loads as one folder.

```
node tools/acmi-to-parquet.mjs <in-folder> <out-folder> [--jobs N] [--theatre Id] [--server Name] [--rounds file.json ...] [--force] [--loose]
```

### `dcs-campaign-rounds.mjs`

A DCS server's campaign rounds from its Tacview recordings alone: each recording's start (the ground units and statics of both sides where the campaign left them) chained per server and map in time order, into rounds, their sessions, the places taken between sessions and, for a round that ended, who held the most (`src/data/dcsCampaign.ts`). Writes one rounds file per server (format heat3d-dcs-rounds, read by `acmi-to-parquet.mjs --rounds`) into the out folder.

```
node tools/dcs-campaign-rounds.mjs <out-folder> <folder>... [--official rounds.json ...] [--cache starts.jsonl]
```

## Geliştiriciler ve belgeler için {#for-developers-and-the-docs}

Bunlar görüntüleyiciyi denetler, demo verileri ve ekran görüntülerini üretir ve başvuru sayfalarını yazar.

### `demo-data.mjs`

Synthetic demo data for the documentation screenshots.

```
node tools/demo-data.mjs [out dir]        (default tools/.shots/demo)
```

### `docs-shots.mjs`

Screenshots for the documentation site, from the synthetic demo data only.

```
node tools/demo-data.mjs                       (once: makes tools/.shots/demo)
node tools/docs-shots.mjs [--lang en] [--only name,name] [--url http://127.0.0.1:5321/]
```

### `docs-refs.mjs`

Writes the documentation's reference pages from the code, so they cannot drift from it: event types and classes, the column names the loader recognises, the languages, the browser keys the viewer keeps, the settings kept in the browser, the value tables and the command-line tools.

```
node tools/docs-refs.mjs [--lang en] [--check]
```

### `smoke.mjs`

Headless smoke test.

```
node tools/smoke.mjs [url]
```

### `check-visual.mjs`

Visual checks on rendered frames: the bugs a user would otherwise find by looking.

```
npm run check:visual                     all three, WebGL2
npm run check:visual -- --webgpu         also on WebGPU
npm run check:visual -- --only=jitter    one property (zoom | flicker | jitter | frametime)
npm run check:visual -- --only=frametime --webgpu --gpu   frame times on this machine's GPU (Edge)
npm run check:visual -- --url=http://127.0.0.1:5285/   against a server already running
```

### `convert-media.mjs`

Convert reference media into PNGs that can be read directly.

```
node tools/convert-media.mjs image <in.avif> <out.png>
node tools/convert-media.mjs video <in.mp4> <outDir> [count]
```

### `probe-webgpu.mjs`

Find a headless Chromium configuration that exposes a WebGPU adapter.

### `probe-present.mjs`

Find a headless configuration whose WebGPU canvas is actually composited.

```
node tools/probe-present.mjs [url]
```

## Kitaplıklar {#libraries}

`container.mjs` komut satırı olmayan bir kitaplıktır: yukarıdaki araçlar, [.3dheat dosyasını](container.md) okumak ve yazmak için onu içe aktarır.
